module: Node "Toggle Vehicle Controls" (category `repeat_instant`). Enables or disables the action map `VehicleCommonActionMap` (`setEnabled(controllable)`), hence the vehicle controls for the player. Input pin: `controllable` (bool). On stop, the controls are re-enabled.
notes: `C.todo`: "PlayerUsable has bugs and only works the first time" (text copied from Player Usable).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStopped.desc: Re-enables the action map when the project stops.
